Name: Communicating Entities in Context
Description: Talk with the machine, face to face, in your language: it understands you and the context and answers with its avatar, in the language you choose.
Asks: a picture of your face, or the camera
what you say: typed, a WAV file, or the microphone
the language you speak and the language of the answer
Keeps: Nothing: the answers are written where the user says.
